files.reason: useRemovalOptions sends the query param `remove`, but the V5 API expects `removeFromClient`. The param is ignored, the server default (true) applies, and Ignore removes the item from the client.
RemoveAction/RemoveMany default removeFromClient=true, and Remove() only calls IgnoreDownload when removeFromClient is false. This is the server side of the ignore path.
Removal-method UI (removeFromClient / ignore / changeCategory) that feeds the removal options.
Defines removalMethod values and the default 'removeFromClient'.
Implements IgnoreDownload by publishing DownloadIgnoredEvent. It is unlikely to be the bug but is the target path.
Handles Ignored tracked-download state when processing and removing completed downloads.
